normalization: lowercase; every character that is not a letter/digit (str.isalnum) and not whitespace replaced with a space (covers punctuation and math symbols such as + = x / so '10+4=?' and '10 + 4 = ?' normalize alike); whitespace runs collapsed to one space; strip ends; SHA-256 hex of the UTF-8 normalized string
note: Hashes only. The raw heldout prompts are NEVER committed to the repo. Exact/normalized overlap -> hold/reword, never land.
